title: Water quality, bed-sediment quality, and simulation of potential contaminant transport in Foster Creek, Berkeley County, South Carolina, 1991-93
citation: Campbell, T.R., and Bower, D.E., 1996, Water quality, bed-sediment quality, and simulation of potential contaminant transport in Foster Creek, Berkeley County, South Carolina, 1991-93: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 95-4247, map scale 1:55,600.
reader: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), scheduled Claude Code session 2026-10-04
notes:
Pages 1-58 (of 145). A surface-water and bed-sediment quality report for Foster Creek (Naval Weapons Station, Berkeley County). Geologic content is limited to the setting paragraph (page 20) and the ground-water summaries for SWMU 3 and SWMU 4 (page 17, from U.S. Department of Navy, 1993). Water-quality sample-site coordinates (tables 3-4), analyte lists (table 2), rainfall (table 1) and passive-vapor benzene counts (table 5) are not geologic values and are not recorded. Table 5 continues into the next packet. The report's reference list is in a later packet.
Pages 59-115 (the PDF skips pages 68 and 75). Content is water-quality results (tables 5-7), bed-sediment chemistry, SCS runoff and BRANCH particle-tracking simulations, summary and references; none of it is geologic, so only references are recorded. Table 7 continues into the next packet. References recorded are those about South Carolina (hydrology, the Naval Weapons Station investigations, the Berkeley County soil survey, local topographic quadrangles). Skipped general references: Berkeley-Charleston-Dorchester COG 1990, Bodhaine 1969, Buchanan and Somers 1969, Cossa and others 1983, DiToro and others 1991, FEMA 1982, Hershfield 1961, Matthai and others 1972, McCuen 1982, NOAA 1991-1992, Regan and Schaffranek 1985, Savannah Laboratories 1991, Schaffranek and others 1981, Searle 1976, Smith and others 1987, SCS 1986, SCDHEC 1992, U.S. Navy 1988 and 1992, USEPA 1986-1992, Vroblesky and others 1991, Ward and Harr 1990. Entries whose author is a repeated-author dash are cited with the author restored; the quote holds only the date and title.
Pages 116-145: the end-of-report tables only. Table 7 continued (pages 116-133, storm-flow water chemistry), table 8 (pages 134-139, bed-sediment chemistry, total organic carbon and percent solids at 12 sites, February 1993) and table 10 (pages 140-145, hourly rainfall, June and August 1992). None of these are geologic units, borings, structures or aquifer properties, so no values are recorded. Bed-sediment chemistry could be added later if the project starts storing sediment geochemistry.
